claim_boundary: component proof from confirmed mapping plus persisted candidate plus completed runtime attempt to official message and paired events; no production publisher, service/API, opening, resume, effect or adapter

write_scope_constraints.migration_015: create only runtime_attempt_result_acceptances; no backfill or legacy schema mutation; direct references to exact confirmed mapping/source message, completed runtime attempt, active candidate and candidate receipt, official message, ordered event pair, confirmed run/graph and runtime_group_heads composite (graph_id,group_id,group_version)
write_scope_constraints.confirmed_bus: pure closed validation and deterministic projection/identity helpers only; no SQLite, journal, clock, environment, service, API, artifacts, provider or adapter dependency
write_scope_constraints.focused_test: own all generic RuntimeJournal command and mutation closures; create candidate, completed attempts and required Group phase/visibility only as labelled test prerequisites; execute official acceptance atomically and create zero effects
write_scope_constraints.heads_regression_test: change only the exact user_version/migration expectation needed for ordered migration 015; preserve all HEADS behavioral assertions
write_scope_constraints.confirmation_regression_test: change only migration version/name/checksum expectations from 14 to 15; preserve AUTH1-8 and all other behavior
write_scope_constraints.traceability: add real focused selectors for T-ACI-R5, T-ACI-R6, T-ACI-R8, T-ACI-R15, T-ACI-R16 and the bounded CONT integration; change the validator only if the registry shape requires it
write_scope_constraints.stage_e: add the three new BUS files, refresh modified in-scope pins, append bounded evidence and refresh the receipt sidecar; expected manifest cardinality is 75/75
write_scope_constraints.errors: reuse the existing closed generic error vocabulary; errors.py is pinned and outside write scope

group_aggregate_identity.authority: derive run_id and graph_id from confirmed_turn_graphs and local group_id/version from the exact confirmed mapping; caller input cannot override any coordinate

component_contract.mapping: resolve one continuation_input_mappings row and derive source_message_id, type, operation, seat, round, local group and dispatch exactly
component_contract.attempt: require runtime_agent_attempts.state=completed and exact dispatch, graph, operation, seat and turn; test prerequisite must be journal-backed
component_contract.candidate: require active publication_candidates row, exact persisted publication_receipts bytes/identity and exact derived source_message_id/group aggregate/attempt/operation/seat/round/type/payload
component_contract.phase: author.output requires the harness-owned authoring Group in collecting and emits position.accepted; reviewer.output requires the review Group in deliberating with reply visibility and emits critique.accepted
component_contract.atomic_acceptance: one journal transaction revalidates all parents, CASes candidate active to officially_accepted, inserts one official messages row and one runtime_attempt_result_acceptances row, advances the exact composite Group head and commits both ordered events or none
component_contract.replay: same derived scoped key and semantic digest returns the byte-identical stored receipt; drift conflicts; concurrent equal commands converge; distinct candidates/attempts for the same logical mapping have one winner
component_contract.continuation: candidate-only rows remain invisible; after both exact official contributions, existing CONT resolution sees the two confirmed facts without BUS changing service.py or continuation.py

test_matrix.migration: apply/reopen idempotently; exactly one isolated table; user_version 15; exact parents/composite FK/uniqueness; zero backfill; legacy schema/rows unchanged
test_matrix.pure_projection: closed inputs, both group aggregate goldens, source_message_id derivation, exact type-to-event mapping and field-by-field authority drift rejection
test_matrix.candidate_exclusion: candidate plus receipt without official verification creates no messages/acceptance and remains invisible to continuation
test_matrix.official_pair: author emits attempt.result_accepted then position.accepted; reviewer emits attempt.result_accepted then critique.accepted; exact source message IDs become official messages
test_matrix.cas_replay_races: stable replay/reopen, semantic drift, stale candidate/Group head, equal concurrency convergence and distinct attempt/candidate one-winner behavior
test_matrix.atomicity: fail after every event, candidate CAS, message, acceptance and Group-head boundary; reopen proves all-or-none and lost-response retry returns original receipt
test_matrix.authority_negatives: wrong mapping/source message/run/graph/group/version/aggregate/attempt state/operation/seat/turn/candidate/receipt/payload/type/round/phase/reply visibility rejects with zero surface mutation
test_matrix.continuation_integration: zero/one official sources remain unsatisfied; exact author+review pair is visible through existing CONT resolution; no effective input, resume or effect is created
test_matrix.surface: no service.py, journal.py, API, __init__, confirmation, continuation, opening, effect, provider/tool/adapter or production publisher change

promotion_boundary: BUS-001 may prove only the bounded component; after PASS stop at PRODUCT-PASS before opening, Run ready, effective input, resume, effects or adapters
